title: Questions 172-175 refer to the following online chat discussion.
passage_1:
Amara Diop (2:15 P.M.)
Hi, team. I’ve just come off the phone with the brand manager at Solberg Drinks about our proposal for their new bottle range.

Tomas Rehak (2:17 P.M.)
Oh, really? Were they happy with the direction?

Amara Diop (2:19 P.M.)
Yes, they liked it a lot. They do have a request, though. They plan to launch the campaign two weeks ahead of schedule to get ahead of a competitor’s release.

Ines Kowalski (2:20 P.M.)
Three weeks sooner? That sounds rather tight. Remember we’re still finalizing the labels for the Halcyon Tea account.

Tomas Rehak (2:21 P.M.)
We can manage that. In fact, the Halcyon labels are all but finished. I finished the artwork yesterday, and they go to press this Thursday, which is ahead of schedule.

Ines Kowalski (2:23 P.M.)
Oh, I hadn’t heard. That’s a relief! In that case, we should have the capacity to concentrate on Solberg’s request.

Amara Diop (2:26 P.M.)
Great. I’ll send the revised proposal to Solberg by tomorrow morning.
